metadataRaw.title: The 2 Muscles Ruining Your Posture (How to FIX Them)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe explains how two muscles could be ruining your posture.

A major cause of rounded upper-back posture is a buildup of weakness and tightness in the rhomboid and trapezius muscles.

Over time, this can lead to back stiffness and make it harder to maintain good posture.

To help fix this, we’ll go over easy exercises designed to stretch and strengthen these muscles, improve rounded posture, and help you stand taller.

Each exercise works differently, so go through them all and use the ones that give you the most improvement.

Watch now and start fixing your posture!
